name: mcp-docker
title: The submission MCP from Docker, inspected
description: A look under the hood: the DIY Accounting Submit MCP server, run from its Docker image, answering a developer tool (MCP Inspector) by opening an example book and working out its VAT return boxes.

localApp.command: sed "s|__FIXTURES__|$PWD/videos/books|" videos/fixtures/mcp-inspector-config-docker.json > target/mcp-inspector-config-docker.json && DANGEROUSLY_OMIT_AUTH=true CLIENT_PORT=6274 npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --web --config target/mcp-inspector-config-docker.json --server diya-submit-docker
localApp.readyPattern: MCP Inspector Web is up and running

steps.caption: One docker run command starts the submission server. This tool watches it work.
steps.headline: A developer's view

steps.caption: Switching it on starts the container and opens a channel to it.
steps.headline: Connect to the server
steps.note: The accessible switch sits under its own track span, which intercepts a direct click; the enclosing .mantine-Switch-root label does not.

steps.label: the connection to come up
steps.caption: Connected. The server just listed the tools it offers.
steps.headline: Now connected

steps.caption: It offers 26 tools. Some read a book, some file with HMRC.
steps.headline: See the tools

steps.caption: open_book loads a set of accounts from a file.
steps.headline: Open open_book

steps.caption: A real example: the books of a small building firm.
steps.headline: Point it at a book
steps.note: fill, not type: a plain path value, and the Mantine input's own keystroke handling runs past the typing cadence tolerance.

steps.caption: Running it loads the book and runs its checks.
steps.headline: Open the book

steps.label: the book summary to come back
steps.caption: The book is open. It has 171 lines and no failed checks.
steps.headline: The book is open

steps.caption: derive_vat_return works out the nine VAT boxes for one quarter.
steps.headline: Open derive_vat_return

steps.caption: Nothing is sent to HMRC. This tool only reads the book.
steps.headline: Work out the boxes

steps.label: the VAT boxes to come back
steps.caption: The nine boxes come back, each worked out from the book's own lines.
steps.headline: The boxes come back

steps.caption: Net VAT due for the quarter, ready to check before anything is filed.
steps.headline: Net VAT due
